v: Brahmotsavam tarvatha na patience ni ila test chesina movie idhe 🙏😪 20-min story ni 150 mins ‘realism’ peru tho stretch chesi champesaru.
e: Falaknuma Das has a few actors doing genuinely good work, but their effort disappears inside a 150-minute film that felt painfully stretched and repetitive. I am normally open to realistic cinema, but here the refusal to use emotion, twists or entertainment made the so-called realism feel more like a test of patience than a strength.
body:
one of the worst movies I have ever seen after Bhramotsavam…..a story line which would have been apt for a 20 mins short film was stretched stretched stretched into a 150 mins film!!!!

this movie will be an example where how the audience patience will be tested if the director doesnt want to take any cinematic liberty and doesnt want to include any emotions twists or entertainment and solely depends on so called realistic approach!!!!!!

few of the actors performed excellent but all their efforts go in vain as we see the same far stretched repeated scenes without any purpose!!!

I am generally open to different geners and realistic films….but this movie has tested my patience as there was nothing expect the directors over zeal to make an realistic film with realistic story with realistic emotions and realistic dialogues.

a normal cine goer will be totally pissed of with this movie….a total waste of time!!!!!

v: REEListic story with REAListic emotions 🙏 Nani ki ee role cakewalk laga untundi. Mass kosam kaadu... emotion connect ayithe Jersey definitely hits hard.
e: Jersey is unapologetically emotional rather than mass entertainment, so its impact depends heavily on what kind of cinema you enjoy. For viewers who connect with realistic drama, Nani’s effortless performance, Gowtam Tinnanuri’s direction, well-shot cricket scenes and touching dialogues make it a deeply rewarding watch.
body:
REEListic Story dealt with REAListic emotions!!!!

a Must watch if you are a fan of movies with emotional content!!!! a one time watch if you are normal movie lover and a Never watch if you are purely into Entertainment or Mass Movies!!!!

What could have been an award winning ir once in life time performance for many other actors…had been a simple cake-walk performance for Nani!!!

Director had done full justice to the emotional theme of the movie and also the cricketing scenes have been shot really well!!!

Audio is pretty ordinary but the BGM though sublime was pretty good in elevating the emotional mood of the film!!!!

Heroine Shraddha, Satyaraj and the little Kid have done complete justice to their respective roles!!!

special mention of the superb dialogues which sounded pretty real and touching like few below….

Baaga aade vadini Captain cheyaaru……aadu Captain avuthe andhharini baagha adisthadu annukunodine Captain ni chestharu!!!!

aadi vyasu ki artham kakappvachu gaani…naaa manusuku telusu ra mosam chesanu anni!!!

maa naana prayatnisthu chanipoyadu anukunam kadhaaa…..kaadhu chanipothadani telisinaa prayatninchaadu!!!

naaku aapu ichinolantha guda nanu dabbullu epudu thirigi isthavu ra anni epudu adagaaru!!! adhi naa medha prema tho kadhu……nenu thirigi ivalenanna namakam tho!!!

v: FUN kosam vellanu... FRUSTRATION ekkuva vachindi 😪 Story, comedy, songs, overacting anni test chesayi. Vintage Venky comedy okkate naaku real fun.
e: F2 reminded me of the old family multi-starrers where frustrated husbands run away from domestic life, get into trouble and eventually rediscover the value of family. Anil Ravipudi revives that template with plenty of loud comedy, but almost everything irritated me except Venkatesh slipping comfortably back into his vintage comic zone.
body:
I felt FRUSTRATED more than fun!!!!

back then in late 90’s and early 20’s there used to be a trend of so called “Family Multi Starrers” where a Group of friends and Husbands get vexed with their Families/Wifves and go on a wrong path….then due to circumstances they realize the importance of happy wedding and importance of wife and story ends!!! with endless and mindless comedy wrapped all over the plot like…..Sandade Sandadi….Kshemamga Velli Labhamga Randi….etc

which had the slowly fading heros either Srikanth/Jagapathi Babu , upcoming and struggling hero Shivaji and Rajendra Prasad as lead caste!!!!

Mr. Anil has got INSPIRED from the same golden era…..and casted Venkatesh, Varun and again MR.Rajendra Prasad!!!!

The Film had Frustrating Story….Frustrating silly Comedy….Frustrating Songs and BGM….Frustrating Family….Frustratingly overacting Heroins and Prakashraj!!!

the only FUN is to see Vintage Venky who had done comedy movie after a long time!!!!

v: Ram Charan did a Balakrishna 😂 Boyapati regular excess ni kuda OVER-dose chesadu. Physics, biology, geography anni holiday lo... Charan మాత్రం madness ni confidently survives.
e: Vinaya Vidheya Rama takes every familiar Boyapati ingredient and pushes it several levels beyond excess: more emotion, more villainy, louder dialogues, bigger fights and logic that disappears almost completely. Ram Charan’s ease with the high-voltage material is the only real positive I found, even though my daughter apparently had a very different verdict 😄
body:
Ram Charan did a Balakrishna!!!!!

the normal template of Boyapati is…..an Emotional Family!!! a Powerful Hero!!! a Cruel Villan!!! High Voltage Dialogues !!! High Top class Fights!!! and weak Physics!!!!

but with Ram Charan & High budget on board…..Boya ensured an OVER Emotional Family!!!! an OVER Powerful Hero!!! an OVER Cruel Villan!!! OVER Voltage Dialogues!!! Over the Top Fights!!!! and Weakest Physics!!!!

this time he ensured to Brutally Rape Biology, Geography, Civics along with Physics!!!!

while Boya was busy with above….DSP ensured he did his bit to rape the concept of Music and BGM _/\_

the only positive in the whole movie is Ram Charan…who was completely at ease in deleviring this High voltage Dialogues and Fights!!!

PS : MY DAUGHTER LOVED THE MOVIE!!!!
